citation: Carpenter, T. P., & Moser, J. M. (1984). The acquisition of addition and subtraction concepts in grades one through three. Journal for Research in Mathematics Education, 15(3), 179–202.

citation: Geary, D. C., Hoard, M. K., & Nugent, L. (2012). Independent contributions of the central executive, intelligence, and in-class attentive behavior to developmental change in the strategies used to solve addition problems. Journal of Experimental Child Psychology, 113(1), 49–65.

evidence_notes: DOI and metadata checked in Crossref; full author-hosted article checked, including definitions, both experiments, and General Discussion.

topic: adaptive strategy choice; jump and split strategies

evidence_notes: DOI and metadata checked in Crossref; full author-uploaded article checked, including task definitions, sample, Results, tables, and Discussion.

topic: strategy selection and execution; working memory
